blind.B1: Every one of the 12 sequenced myobundles was electrically stimulated (S2.5.p1: E-Stim days 14-21; GEO treatment field '( EStim)' on all samples). The only factors are tomatidine vs vehicle and YA vs OS donors. No unstimulated RNA-seq arm, so no exercise contrast can be estimated; it is an in-vitro exercise-like model with a drug question (title; S3.2). Not analyzable for an exercise-effect question.
blind.B2: S3.2.p1 / S2.7.p1: tomatidine vs matched E-Stim control within YA (n=3 vs 3; 215 up/219 down) and within OS (n=3 vs 3; 12 up/2 down). Groups: YA control 3, YA tomatidine 3, OS control 3, OS tomatidine 3.
blind.B3: S2.1.p1: 5 volunteers supplied cells but the paper does not map chips to donors. Library names carry MP17/MP20 and chip numbers, which may be run or donor codes but are undocumented. Candidate keys (title suffix 'replicate k', 3 keys, one per level) are only replicate labels; the expression check is not_supported (same-key r -0.08, p 0.82). No supported repeated-measure unit.
blind.B4: The paper does not say whether a joint model or per-pair fits were used; S2.6.p1 only says DESeq2, and S2.7.p1 normalizes each cohort to its matched control.
blind.B5: S2.6.p1: 'Differential expression analysis was performed using the DESeq2 package, with an FDR-corrected p-value threshold of 0.05. The results were further filtered to extract transcripts showing a 2.0-fold change (log_2FC) in either direction.' Counts: YA 215 up/219 down; OS 12 up/2 down (S3.2.p1). Whether the cutoff is inclusive and whether 2.0 means |log2FC|>=1 or log2FC=2.0 is ambiguous in the text.

checks.evidence: S2.5.p1 and GEO treatment field: 12/12 stimulated; no unstimulated arm. Refusal matches B1 and the series is labelled as an in-vitro exercise-like drug study.
Derived cohort/trt levels give YA 6, OS 6, vehicle 6, tomatidine 6; four cells of n=3 match S3.2 and Table 1. No exclusions.

packet B says 'donor cell lines pooled per cohort (one YA and one OS donor source)', but S2.1.p1 says n=5 volunteers and no pooling or chip-to-donor map is in the paper text. Expression check not_supported. Stop does not depend on pairing.
checks.fix: Reword the repeated_measure_unit note to 'chip-to-donor mapping not documented (n=5 volunteers, S2.1.p1)' instead of asserting one donor per cohort; ask the authors if the drug contrasts are ever run.

checks.evidence: No fit; the paper is silent on joint vs pairwise (B4).
YA vs OS aliased with donor source; recorded in the design reasoning. Chip/MP run codes unreviewed but not relevant to the refusal.
GEO data_processing: non-normalized FPKM; file genes.fpkm.tsv.gz, 31% non-integer. The paper's DESeq2 on RSEM counts cannot be reproduced; limma on log2(FPKM+1) would be a declared deviation.
Recorded as FDR 0.05 with |log2FC| 1.0 (S2.6.p1). The paper writes '2.0-fold change (log_2FC)', which is ambiguous; the record states cutoff 1.0 without noting that ambiguity.
checks.fix: If drug contrasts are ever run, record the ambiguity and test both log2FC 1 and 2.

checks.evidence: HANDBACK quotes the paper counts (434 and 14) as not reproduced and claims no ours-vs-paper comparison.
'No unstimulated arm' is established by the GEO treatment field on all 12 samples, library names (all Estim) and S2.5.p1/Table 1; the search was wide enough.

human_items: Open policy: whether an in-vitro exercise-like (electrical pulse) stimulation series with the drug as the only varied factor counts as an exercise study; the refusal is consistent with the skill rule but the person may want the tomatidine-vs-vehicle contrasts run and labelled as a drug effect under E-Stim.
summary: 该系列12个肌管全部接受电刺激，没有未刺激的RNA-seq对照，因此拒绝做运动对比的理由成立，证据充分。论文的比较是各队列内他莫替丁对溶剂（YA 3对3，OS 3对3），分组与阈值（FDR 0.05，2倍变化）记录基本正确。仅有两处次要问题：关于“每个队列只有一个供体来源”的说法论文中没有依据（论文称5名志愿者），以及2.0倍变化的写法有歧义。
